info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Hedge Fund Administration API
info.description: The Hedge Fund Administration API enables users to access and manage various market operations related to hedge funds. This API allows financial institutions and asset managers to retrieve crucial data regarding hedge fund activities, including transaction histories, valuations, and compliance metrics. Typical consumers of this API include hedge fund administrators, compliance officers, and finance analysts who need real-time insights into financial operations. The endpoint provides essential information to streamline operations and enhance decision-making in hedge fund management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about hedge fund administration operations, including relevant metrics and statuses. It is crucial for users to maintain an overview of hedge fund activities and ensures that stakeholders have access to important data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the hedge fund administration operations details. Provide necessary parameters in the JSON format to specify the required data for the GET request.

200.description: Successful retrieval of hedge fund administration data.
